auditor: kernel implementation subagent; self-review, not an independent third-party replication
mode: Read-only CPU audit of existing source, generated code, logs and raw timings; no new GPU jobs

decision.confidence_scope: Strong evidence for the measured SM120 implementations and operator replay shapes; no universal impossibility claim.
decision.supported_conclusion: Current v2/v3 dynamic-row implementations do not meet the approximately 15% first-round speed signal against the independently tuned fixed-row E2. Natural diagnostic replay is slower in both cache controls. The conclusion does not rely on native FlashInfer timing or the newer union metadata.
decision.stage_name_correction: Proposal section 5.6 names P1 as application qualification and P2 as operator qualification. These experiments do not complete formal P1 or P2. The supported no-go is an economical stop of the present operator/integration direction under section 6, not a completed negative P1 application trial.

gate_audit.requirement: Natural captures should show about 15% stable complete-call gain, exceeding twice A/A noise, over fixed-row accumulation, best fixed partition and exact hierarchy before full integration.
gate_audit.finding: Necessary fixed-row comparison fails on all four measured old-30B QMSum layer snapshots: fixed/candidate hot ratios 0.7885–0.8095 and cold 0.8421–0.8881. No positive 15% signal exists. All four cases use the same document/step, so they are four layer snapshots, not four independent documents.
gate_audit.decision: Sufficient to withhold further integration of this implementation on the measured scope. Not sufficient to claim that the prescribed official-model, six-document natural suite has been completed.

gate_audit.requirement: Record failure if row switching/on-chip traffic, spill or split erase savings.
gate_audit.finding: Reduced logical M tiles do not translate into a net producer-plus-merge gain after per-arm split tuning. Compiled SMEM/register footprints substantiate a resource cost. No local-memory spill is present in the recorded cubins. Traffic, stall and occupancy causes are not directly measured.
gate_audit.decision: Measured net-cost failure is supported for this implementation. A specific causal claim about bank conflicts, DRAM bandwidth, achieved occupancy or spills is not supported.

gate_audit.requirement: P1 compares A0–A4 on original eight development reports, main-model TP2, with common-ready, full costs and application upper bounds.
gate_audit.finding: No complete P1 application comparison, quality-constrained dominating alternative or removable-attention upper bound is established by the kernel evidence.
gate_audit.decision: Formal P1 failure or success remains unevaluated by this audit. Do not substitute kernel replay for application JCT/quality.

gate_audit.requirement: Formal P2 uses main-model six-document snapshots, four prescribed layers and naturally reached 1/16/64/256 steps, all KV heads per rank, E0–E6.
gate_audit.finding: Primary audited natural kernel replay covers one old-BF16-model QMSum meeting, four layers, step 1 and two KV heads. Synthetic and bounded-layout tests supplement it.
gate_audit.decision: Exploratory operator qualification only; E1 best fixed partition and E4 exact hierarchy are not directly measured. Their absence cannot rescue a required gain that already fails versus E2, but prevents claiming exhaustive baseline coverage.

correctness_audit.topic: Exact same mask and physical source
correctness_audit.result: No mismatch found in the execution contract.
evidence: make_plan groups every nonzero owner token once into disjoint regions; active row maps are unique and bounded.
All tile methods read the same q/k/v tensors and index metadata. Payloads are not duplicated per request by the operators.
FlashInfer flattens (head,request) and uses page-size-one indices head*N+token; k/v are views of the same physical source.

Natural replay concatenates system prefix, document and complete per-request suffix once into the common source and marks private suffix ownership. Queries and cached keys retain the captured RoPE transforms.
limits: Capture construction and model correctness were not independently re-executed in this audit.
Sequentially collected natural queries do not establish a simultaneous ready window or shared-cache lifetime in an engine.

correctness_audit.result: FP64 reference is independent of the compact metadata and avoids TF32; eligibility assertions check O and LSE.
evidence: reference defaults to torch.float64 for QK, softmax and PV, using original owner bits directly.
Candidate/E2 emit natural-log LSE. Native log2 LSE is multiplied by ln(2) for correctness comparisons.
Empty rows produce O=0 and LSE=-inf. assert_close validates infinities; the diagnostic max-error nan_to_num is not the qualification decision.
limits: Initial broad screen and 2x2 benchmark use FP32 reference, so their error columns are not FP64 evidence. FP64 unit tests and later paired runs provide the stronger checks.
Tolerances are atol=0.006, rtol=0.015 for O; no separate artifact proves native-calibrated tolerance freezing and complete layer-output/logit verification prescribed by section 5.7.
Natural l47 candidate/fixed max absolute error is 0.0037283956; native reaches 0.0090291050 under relative tolerance. Report actual errors, not an unsupported universal sub-1e-3 bound.
Maximum relative output errors and full-budget equivalence to complete model Dense execution are not recorded.

correctness_audit.result: No outstanding semantic or layout defect identified in the accepted results.
evidence: Generated kernels branch on runtime Count into actual M16 versus M32 GEMMs in one CTA; runtime metadata mutation exercises both branches without recompilation.

v2 preserves canonical FP32 m/l/u across region transitions. v3 preserves u in FP32 registers and stages its exact 32 bits in two BF16-typed scratch cells; there is no numeric BF16 conversion of canonical u.
An early output-store layout permutation was fixed using explicit output stores before the accepted evidence runs; accepted FP64 tests cover all output columns.
Strong E2 keeps Q resident in shared memory and m/l/u in registers across regions, without dynamic canonical-state gather/scatter. It is not the weaker fixed-row mode with artificial remapping.
limits: Coverage includes full/disjoint/cross/tree/mixed/empty, tails, splits, empty rows, B1/B3/B4 and GQA4/8, but does not exhaustively enumerate all alive subsets or all model data distributions.
Tests validate final results; they do not directly inspect every intermediate canonical state or establish a formal proof.

correctness_audit.result: Existing accepted logs show no memory errors or reported shared-memory races.
limits: Sanitizers cover the listed tests, not all possible configurations. Passing racecheck is not proof of race freedom.

performance_audit.result: Candidate and E2 timing includes producer, global split partials and merge; no producer-only speedup is used.
limits: CPU metadata construction, allocation, compilation and planning are outside steady-state timing. Plan preparation is separately reported but not amortized into these ratios.
The natural replay includes private suffix computation, but not selection, model preparation, TP communication, decoding control, queueing or application completion.
A producer-plus-merge loss is sufficient to stop the current implementation; these numbers are not full-application costs.

performance_audit.result: Native correctness is normalized to natural log; native timed run retains log2 LSE.
performance_audit.severity: Reporting caveat; does not invalidate the E2-based no-go.
limits: The ln(2) conversion is performed outside the timing interval. If the caller requires natural-log LSE, native timing is a lower bound for that normalized interface.
Label native timings as its original API or include a timed normalization in any future exact-interface claim. Near-ties against native alone are insufficient.

performance_audit.result: Each arm selects its own qualified best configuration independently for hot and cold cache before the paired measurements.
evidence: v2 synthetic grid: N32/64, splits16/32/64/128, threads128/256, with explicit failed configurations retained.
Natural diagnostic grid: N32/64, splits16/64/128, threads128.
Native retries use 512 MiB workspace; cache-retuned runs do not silently exclude the earlier 128 MiB workspace failures.
v3 bounded candidate is N64/128 threads with splits16/32/64/128; fixed retains N32/64 and native retains its choices.
limits: Some N32/256-thread compact shapes fail TileLang warp_col_tiles constraints. These are implementation failures, not zero/slow timing samples.
No two-stage pipeline, hand-CUDA rewrite or exhaustive layout search was performed. The negative result is not a theorem about the best possible implementation.
Natural tuning is narrower than synthetic tuning; all official P2 shapes and all KV heads were not covered.

performance_audit.result: CPU recomputation confirms stored medians, ratios, A/A and tuning selection for all audited paired files.
evidence: Each cache regime has 30 randomized blocks and a reverse-order repeat, with all methods on the same physical GPU.
Bootstrap resamples blocks, retaining paired random/reverse measurements. Original raw measurements remain available.
Hot uses 20 calls per graph; cold uses one call after a flush larger than twice reported L2. Flush is outside timing.
limits: Cold single-call timing is visibly quantized around 2.048 microseconds; zero-width bootstrap intervals do not imply exact population certainty.
Artificial flush is a controlled cold-cache condition, not the proposal's natural rotating-capture or identical model-prefix execution.
These are within-run timing intervals. Many blocks/layers/GPUs are not independent documents or model seeds.
Multiple physical GPUs are used, but a complete prescribed same-case second-card method-swap matrix and frozen twice-A/A decision statistic are not documented for the entire suite.
Minor near-ties, including v3 128K, must not be generalized. The large natural E2 gaps and lack of any 15% gain support the scoped stop.

performance_audit.result: 48 raw configurations, zero failures, with full source preserved; useful diagnostic, not a strong E3 comparison.
limits: Region-partial variants write full canonical row slots including inactive zeros; optimized packed-active E3 is not implemented.
Nine hot samples in fixed method order lack the paired random/reverse protocol; tuning winners are exploratory.
The 64K fused compact timing (30.27776 us) beats fused fixed (32.44160 us) in this diagnostic slice. Preserve it; it is below the proposed 15% signal and fixed partial is faster (25.24096 us).

performance_audit.topic: Union metadata bug reported by parent
performance_audit.result: Three audited newer union raw files include fixed_AA in methods and an extra fixed_AA_over_compact summary. Parent corrected loop-variable shadowing in source and plans a sidecar annotation.
performance_audit.severity: Metadata/extra-summary defect only in these files.
evidence: Raw times, fixed/native/union median ratios, per-cache best-config choice and random/reverse order recompute correctly.
Older v2 natural and v3 files are unaffected. Core no-go does not depend on this union extension.
performance_audit.action: Keep original files and annotate provenance; do not silently rewrite correctly collected measurements.

resource_audit.fields_verified: GPU arch, shape, generated-source SHA256, cubin SHA256, registers, static+dynamic shared memory, stack/local bytes
resource_audit.finding: v3 reduces SMEM but raises registers and does not recover a stable performance gain. Recorded cubins have zero stack/local-memory allocation.
limitations: Compiler resource counts support capacity arguments, not achieved occupancy or causal traffic attribution.
Unprivileged Nsight Compute returned ERR_NVGPUCTRPERM; no root access was used. No measured DRAM/L2 bytes, dynamic tensor instructions, bank conflicts or stalls are claimed.
Plan.statistics reports logical tile estimates; it is not a hardware counter.
The v1 N64 cubin is a compiled resource-failing configuration and is not a valid performance sample.

remaining_claims_not_supported: General infeasibility of dynamic row compaction on other architectures, compilers or layouts.
Completed official Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507-FP8 TP2 deployment/application evaluation.
Official six-document natural P2 suite, complete E0–E6 comparison or full alive-subset correctness coverage.
Natural common-ready lifetime, whole-document JCT, quality non-inferiority, capacity or energy improvement.
A measured specific bank-conflict, DRAM-traffic, occupancy or spill explanation for the latency gap.
recommended_report_wording: On SM120, our numerically validated BranchTile prototypes failed the planned approximately 15% operator signal after independent tuning. On the tested old-model QMSum diagnostic captures they were slower than the fixed-row on-chip control, so we stopped this implementation before full application integration. Formal application qualification and the prescribed official-model natural suite remain incomplete.
